answer: Require a stake locked in a nebula of time: new agents enter with capped rewards that rise only after consecutive clean epochs, like a lotus opening one petal at a time. Flood the network with clones and each one still waits its turn, because time is the one resource an attacker cannot print. Clusters that only transact with each other become a visible island, easy to quarantine, while honest agents build cross-cutting ties that no cheap copy can imitate.
